title: Estimate Shipping — sidebar cart modal
description:
Client wants an Estimate Shipping feature inside the sidebar/drawer cart. Needs full planning and research before implementation can begin.

Scope as described:
- A button labelled "Estimate Shipping" visible in the sidebar cart
- Clicking opens a modal overlay
- Modal contains: Country selector, Province/State selector, Postal/ZIP code input, and a Calculate button
- On calculate: calls Shopify Shipping Rates API (/cart/shipping_rates.json) with cart contents + address
- Results displayed as a list of available carriers + prices inside the same modal below the form
- No page navigation — everything in-modal

Research needed before dev:
1. Shopify Shipping Rates API format + CORS requirements (requires server-side proxy or storefront API)
2. Whether cart must have items for rates to return (empty cart edge case)
3. Province dropdown dynamic population based on selected country
4. How to handle multiple currencies / market rates
5. Error states (invalid postal, no rates available, API timeout)
6. Integration point: which cart file (main-cart-celebrate-festival.liquid or quick-cart.liquid / cart-drawer)
expected_behavior: User clicks "Estimate Shipping" button in the cart sidebar. A modal opens with Country, Province, Postal Code fields and a Calculate button. After filling and clicking Calculate, a list of shipping options with carrier names and rates appears below the form in the same modal. No page reload.

title: AI chatbot page — messages not scrollable when chat gets long
description:
On the AI Kitchen Consultant page (/pages/ai-kitchen-consultant), when the conversation grows long the chat messages overflow out of the viewport with no scroll. User cannot read earlier messages.

Root cause: .cf-ai__center (the center flex column) was missing overflow:hidden and min-height:0. In a CSS grid with height:100vh, grid children need these to be constrained. Without them, .cf-ai__center grew past the viewport so the inner .cf-chatbot__body overflow-y:auto never activated.

Fix applied:
1. sections/page-ai-assistant.liquid:42 — added overflow:hidden + min-height:0 to .cf-ai__center
2. assets/cf-chatbot.css:58 — added min-height:0 to .cf-chatbot__body to complete the flex shrink chain
expected_behavior: Chat messages area scrolls vertically when conversation is longer than the viewport. Earlier messages remain accessible by scrolling up.

title: Chatbot — messages overflow and push page, no inner scroll

Reproduced with repeated product queries (e.g. Robot Coupe food processors).

See attachment for a screenshot of the overflow state.
expected_behavior: Chat card has a fixed height and its message list scrolls internally. Top bar (title + close) and composer stay pinned regardless of history length.
